profile.capability: Restricted premium tier: advanced reasoning and high-complexity technical tasks (a product tier name, not a literal multiplier).
profile.note: Base model / revision are copied from the existing model configuration and are never changed by the dataset pipeline.
profile.target_note: Approved target set by the project owner on 2026-11-15 (exact).

no_split_leakage.detail: 0 prompts shared between train and eval/test

benchmark_leakage_removed.detail: 18486 evaluation prompts indexed; 10 training records removed

no_missing_sources.detail: all required approved sources present; optional absent: consented-history

approval.attested_by: project owner (Approx Technology) — instruction in the Approx AI build session
approval.statement: Human review of the Approx training datasets is complete; review must not block training.

competition-math.reason: The Hub refuses to serve this dataset (parquet API HTTP 400; reported takedown). Not ingested from any mirror.

smoltalk.reason: No license declared on the card.

slimorca.reason: MIT-tagged but generated with OpenAI GPT-4/3.5; the generator's terms restrict building competing models. Needs legal review.

metamathqa.reason: Generated with GPT-3.5; legal review of generator terms required.

orca-math.reason: Generated with GPT-4 Turbo; legal review of generator terms required.

magicoder-oss.reason: Generated with gpt-3.5-turbo; legal review required.

codealpaca.reason: Generated with text-davinci-003; legal review required.

helpsteer2.reason: Prompts largely from ShareGPT (third-party chat logs; privacy/ToS review needed); responses model-generated.

tulu-3-sft.reason: Aggregate of many sources with their own licenses (some non-commercial / model-generated); must be filtered per subset.

aya-collection.reason: Templated + machine-translated (513M rows). Approved in principle as MACHINE_TRANSLATED data (counts as synthetic); not ingested in this build (size) — enable per language subset.

nemotron-chat.reason: Prompts are taken from LMSYS-Chat-1M, which is distributed under its own restrictive agreement.

nemotron-code.reason: Every inspected prompt is withheld ('-'); prompts must be rebuilt from TACO/APPS/CodeContests, whose licenses differ.

openmathinstruct-2.reason: Generated with Llama-3.1-405B; the Llama 3.1 license requires derived model names to start with 'Llama'.

samvaad-hi.reason: Hindi/Hinglish conversations; the card does not say how they were generated.

urdu-instruct.reason: Generated with GPT-4o (OpenAI terms restrict building competing models).

urdu-assistant.reason: Urdu translation of Alpaca-style data (Alpaca is CC-BY-NC; text-davinci-003 outputs).

mt-urdu-english.reason: 1.4M aggregated pairs (Quran, Bible, subtitles…); upstream corpus licenses not itemised.

roman-urdu-toxic.reason: Toxic-comment corpus (abusive language) — unsuitable as assistant targets.

tatoeba.reason: Human translations (CC-BY-2.0) but no parquet export; needs downloads.tatoeba.org on the network allowlist or an HF token for tatoeba_mt.

kullm-v2.reason: Korean DeepL translations of GPT4All/Dolly/Vicuna — contains OpenAI-model outputs and ShareGPT conversations.

cybernative-dpo.reason: Card warns labels are unverified and training on it degraded coding accuracy.

wildchat-1m.reason: Real user prompts with ChatGPT (OpenAI) responses.

upstream_risks.commitpackft: permissive code licenses (MIT/BSD/Apache) require keeping copyright notices if code is redistributed verbatim; per-row license and repo are kept in the record meta
upstream_risks.nemotron-math: prompts collected by NVIDIA from 'public and open corpora' (not itemised per row)
upstream_risks.nemotron-stem: prompts collected by NVIDIA from 'public and open corpora' (not itemised per row)
upstream_risks.opencodeinstruct: generator model not named on the card; confirm before commercial release (reject = set status to 'rejected' and rebuild)
upstream_risks.roman-urdu-parl: Roman-Urdu authorship (human vs tool) not documented on the card; spot checks show some imperfectly aligned pairs (quality score lowered to 0.5)
upstream_risks.trendyol-cybersec: generation method not named on the card; confirm before commercial release
